Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Sub: Conference Call for the Quarter (Q2) and Half year ended September 30, 2026 – 
Reschedule -Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015 
 
This is in continuation of our intimation dated October 05, 2026, regarding the date of the Board 
Meeting for considering the Un-audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of the 
Bank for the Quarter (Q2) and Half year ended September 30, 2026, and in reference to our 
intimations dated October 08, 2026, reference No. YBL/CS/2026-27/106; October 17, 2026, 
reference Nos. YBL/CS/2026-27/113 and YBL/CS/2026-27/114.  
 
We hereby inform that the Bank will host the conference call (Group Meeting) with analyst and 
investors on Monday, October 19, 2026 at 8:00 am IST (i.e. 10:30 am SGT & HKT / 03:30 am BST 
/ Sunday, October 18 at 10:30 pm EDT) to discuss the Financial Results with the participants. 
The details of the rescheduled Conference Call are enclosed to this letter. 
The weblink of BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited providing the above 
information is being hosted on the Bank’s website www.yes.bank.in pursuant to Listing 
Regulations, as amended. 
This is for your information and appropriate dissemination.  
Thanking you, 
Yours faithfully, 
 
For YES BANK LIMITED 
 
 
 
Sanjay Abhyankar 
Company Secretary 
 
Encl: As above  
SANJAY 
MADHAV 
ABHYANKAR
Digitally signed by 
SANJAY MADHAV 
ABHYANKAR
